name: recon
description: Authorized, owner-operated reconnaissance of a live web product — drive it headless with Playwright and bring back verified, evidence-backed documentation: a build-ready product dossier, feature catalog, per-feature/per-screen specs with the API cause→effect contract, user journey & funnel with a walkthrough video, design language, copy inventory, analytics/events, decoded model layer, positioning, competitor landscape, and battlecard.
